[LIMP.2.1.5] Each segment of a dotted path is an
independently-valid `NAME`. The first segment must
exist as a top-level library in the search path; subsequent
segments narrow the path through directory levels. The
final segment names a `.ds` file. No source-level segment
may be a Python-style `__init__`-equivalent — every dotted
import resolves to exactly one `.ds` file (LIMP.3.1).
